summary: Nokia Corporation filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report) on 25 May 2026, enclosing a managers' transaction disclosure under EU Market Abuse Regulation. Konstanty Owczarek, other senior manager, acquired 32,595 shares at US$15.3457 each on 22 May 2026 via XNYS. No corporate event, merger, acquisition, restructuring, or shareholder return is involved. This is a routine insider-dealing notification, not a special situation. Accordingly, the filing is classified as 'None'.
